author: Development assistant; not an independent evaluator.
purpose: Three first-attempt workflow checks after the earlier repairs. Freeze conversations and expectations before all three model requests; do not change the app, profile, prompt, model or lessons between requests.

checks.fields: Latest mutually accepted counts, date, time, venue, menu and beverage; raw source excerpts must occur in the conversation. Verify meanings manually as well as automated comparisons.
checks.defaults: Unspecified end/timezone stay unknown in the raw answer; prepared defaults are labelled. An explicit accepted end overrides the four-hour rule.
checks.assets: Check all five document states, exact quote arithmetic, kitchen quantities when available, counts/schedule and preserved drink notes. Export every ready document; blocked PDFs must return 409.
checks.persistence: Reopen saved output without AI. Existing events, corrections, reviews and settings remain unchanged. Do not mark new drafts reviewed.
checks.reporting: Report expected allergy blocks as successful safeguards, separately from completed assets. Retain any first-attempt failure; a repaired replay is never a first-attempt success.

cases.conversation:
Diego: Hello, I'm Diego Chen. Can we bring our project team to Linden & Fig on May 14, 2027? We are looking at 5 p.m., Garden Patio, and Menu 2. There will be 22 guests and no children.

Coordinator: We can confirm that date, the 5 p.m. start, Garden Patio and Menu 2. What should we arrange for beverages?

Diego: Juice and soda for everyone, please. No alcohol.

Coordinator: Confirmed as Nonalcoholic service, with juice and soda for everyone and no alcohol.

Diego: Our last four teammates just said yes. Please change our booking to 26 guests, still no children. Everything else stays the same.

Coordinator: All updated: 26 guests and 0 children for May 14, 2027 at 5 p.m., Garden Patio, Menu 2, and the same Nonalcoholic service with juice and soda and no alcohol.

Priya: Hi, I'm Priya Shah. I'd like to celebrate our anniversary at Linden & Fig on June 12, 2027, on the Garden Patio with Menu 2. We have 12 guests and 2 children. Could we do 5:15 to 8 p.m.?

Coordinator: Yes, those arrangements work. What drinks would you like, and are there any allergies or dietary restrictions?

Priya: Beer and wine service, please, with juice and soda for the children. No spirits or cocktails. I've checked with everyone: no allergies or dietary restrictions.

Coordinator: Confirmed. Beer and wine only for guests confirmed to be 21 or older, juice and soda for the children, and no spirits or cocktails. We have your no-allergy reply.

Priya: We need to update two things. The final count is 16 guests and 3 children. Please also move the event to 5:45 p.m. through 8:15 p.m. We have a ride booked afterward, so that end time matters.

Coordinator: Confirmed: June 12, 2027, 5:45 to 8:15 p.m., Garden Patio, 16 guests and 3 children, Menu 2. The beer and wine service and children's juice and soda stay as agreed, with no spirits or cocktails.

Jordan: Hello, I'm Jordan Wells. I'm organizing a family dinner at Linden & Fig on August 20, 2027 at 6 p.m. We'd like the Garden Patio and Menu 2 for 24 guests and 2 children.

Coordinator: We can arrange that. What would you like for drinks?

Jordan: Nonalcoholic service with juice and soda for everyone, and no alcohol.

Coordinator: Confirmed: August 20 at 6 p.m., Garden Patio, Menu 2 and those drinks.

Jordan: Two more relatives are joining us, so the final count is 26 guests and 2 children. Also, one guest has a food allergy. I don't have the details yet; I'll send them when she replies.

Coordinator: The new count is confirmed at 26 guests and 2 children. All other arrangements stay the same. We'll wait for your allergy details before finalizing the kitchen instructions and event plans.

limitations: Three assistant-authored fictional conversations using configured options; this is a small development check, not independent or representative accuracy evidence.
The existing workspace lessons may influence output and must be recorded without changes.
Draft readiness is not human approval, a sent message or a confirmed restaurant booking.
No time-saving or business-impact claim is measured by this check.
